parsed.reason: All facts are conveyed accurately in French with no invented details or promises: no introduction waiting, parent stays open to introductions, Hale texts when a good match is found. The "Merci !" is a natural opener. However, "Vous restez ouvert aux présentations" assumes a masculine gender for the parent (ouvert vs ouverte), which no fact gives. It also reads a bit like a status recap (situation, standing, rule) rather than a friend texting.
